items.title: Vendor failed to meet contractual obligations: Foxconn on payment dispute
items.rss_summary: Taiwanese electronics giant Foxconn on Wednesday alleged that a certain vendor in India has failed to meet agreed contractual obligations. BCD Emprassa, a vendor of Hon Hai Technology Group (Foxconn), has reportedly moved the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) to recover alleged dues of around USD 15 million from the company. "Foxconn clarifies that the dispute arises from the supplier's failure to meet agreed contractual requirements and quality standards. Despite repeated requests for corrective action, the outstanding issues remain unresolved," the company said. BCD Emprassa has reportedly filed a claim regarding 700 residential units for female employees working at its Bengaluru facility. Foxconn said that as the matter is now subject to legal proceedings, the company will take appropriate steps to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests through the legal process and will refrain from commenting further on the specifics of the case. items.title: TVS Motor plans to invest ₹2,000 crore in Tamil Nadu, create 1,000 jobs
items.rss_summary: TVS Motor Company on Wednesday said it plans to invest Rs 2,000 crore in Tamil Nadu over four years and create 1,000 jobs. The two-and three-wheeler maker has entered into a non-binding memorandum of understanding with the Government of Tamil Nadu, according to an exchange filing. Tamil Nadu government, through its nodal agency "Guidance", will provide facilitation and support to TVS Motor in the form of necessary infrastructural support and regulatory facilitation, subject to applicable laws, the filing said.
